The Support, Contact, Notifications and What's new icons in the top bar now unfold their name when you hover over them

Replies to your messages from Contact & Support now arrive as a Discord DM from the bot, and when allowed you can answer once with the Reply button. If the bot can't DM you, the answer shows up in your website notifications instead
Public profiles now show your 6 newest catches and 6 newest special catches instead of 5
Link previews of the Bot, Notifier, Catch stats, Users and Ballsdex pages now use the same bot icon as the favicon
The Collectors → Specials page now has its own link preview card
Link previews (Discord, social media) refreshed: Users, the Ballsdex tabs (account, Raws, Completion, Limits), Notifier and Catch stats now have their own preview cards
Profile previews now also show what someone is looking for and their catches from the last 30 days, and the Collectors preview shows how many collectors are verified
Updated the descriptions in link previews for the Bot, Notifier, Collectors, Users, Profile and Ballsdex pages
/help now points to your Ballsdex account page and lists the newer commands
Link previews of profiles now show animated avatars (their first frame) instead of leaving the avatar out
New /ballsdex completion command: see which Ballsdex balls you own and which are missing (optionally for one special), without syncing
New /ballsdex specials command: prices, event details and market info for any Ballsdex special
New /profile command: a short card of a public BallIdentifier profile, with a link to the full page
You can now add yourself as a collector straight from /collectors and /info with the "I collect" button
Notifications: new types for changes to your Collector entries made by the owner, for problems with a Notifier you set up (deleted role, missing permissions) and for when your turn to sync comes up
You now get a Discord DM when your account is blocked or unblocked

Fewer notifications: thank-you DMs for voting are off by default, Fast Sync no longer sends a notification, and paused syncs, reconnecting or unlinking Ballsdex only appear in your notification list (no DM). You get at most one DM per notification type per hour
Notifier problem alerts reach you only for Notifiers saved after this update, so re-save an older Notifier once to get them
Fixed the Ballsdex Limits tab and sync texts: a sync costs 1 request per 50 balls (not 25), so a 10,000-ball sync takes about 200 requests
Links in the bot's messages now open the website pages directly
Privacy Policy and Terms of Service updated: they now describe website accounts, blocks, profiles, Collectors and Catch stats as they really work
Corrected outdated descriptions: Catch stats rankings cover 30 and 7 days only, Ballsdex sync starts when you press Sync now, and Ballsdex account notifications now say sign-in instead of API key
Buttons and chips are bigger on touch screens, so they are easier to tap
Profile showcase cards line up evenly, and the Looking for editor fits narrow phones
Keyboard focus is now visible in menus and dropdowns
Small labels are a bit larger, and rows you can scroll sideways fade at the edge when there is more
Layouts now switch between phone, tablet and desktop at the same screen widths on every page
New "Looking for" section on profiles: list up to 10 balls, versions or specials you want, each with a priority (Top priority, Wanted, Nice to have)
Manage it in Edit profile; Ballsdex entries can also target regular versions, any special or one specific special
Specials show their emoji when you pick them and in the list on your profile
Accounts blocked by the owner can no longer use the bot's commands and buttons
Accounts can now be blocked by the owner: a blocked user is logged out, can't log in again and sees the reason
Profiles of blocked accounts are hidden
Collectors: you can now add yourself without syncing your Ballsdex account first
Collectors now have two statuses: Verified and Unverified
Ballsdex: if your synced account owns at least half of the required balls you are added as Verified, otherwise as Unverified
Other dexes: you are always added as Unverified, and the owner can verify you
You can have at most 5 Unverified collections per dex
New filter on the Collectors page to show only Verified or only Unverified collectors
Ballsdex sync: after a bot restart, people who were waiting for a free sync slot are remembered and still get the "You can sync now" notification, in the order they asked
Catch stats now count only your last 30 days: the "All time" option is gone from the rankings, /catchstats and your own stats
Your fastest catch, your fastest catch per ball and the server record are still kept, now with the date they were set (shown in /catchstats)
Bot replies after a catch now say "30 days" next to your average
Public profile: the "Catch stats" section is now "Recent catch stats" and shows only the last 30 days
Bot → Catch stats: rankings and your own stats cover 30 or 7 days, and your personal record is shown with its date
Connecting your Ballsdex account no longer starts a sync by itself: start it yourself with Sync now when you want
Collectors: entries of deleted Discord accounts are removed automatically
Spawn Arts: new button next to "Sort by" in View switches between ascending and descending order (remembered for each sort option)
Public profiles: new "Last special catches" section with the newest special balls you caught yourself (shown together with Last catches)
Public profiles: "Last catches" now shows only balls you caught yourself, not ones received in trades
Public profiles with Ballsdex stats now also show "Most specials on one ball"
New site icon: the same countryball face as the bot's avatar
Collectors: fixed a stray "null" shown next to the "I'm a collector" button in dexes other than Ballsdex
Notifier preview: placeholders like {rarity} now show sample values also inside `code` formatting
Bot page: removed the extra Notifier settings button from the top card (the Notifier tab is still right below)
Collectors has a new Specials tab: add yourself as a collector of any Ballsdex special.
Profiles show the specials someone collects next to the balls they collect
New heart button in the top bar: Project Support
New message button in the top bar: send a suggestion, bug report or question straight to the owner (Discord login required, one message every 10 minutes)
Specials: the Market button no longer disappears when the Ballsdex market data can't be fetched. Previous numbers are kept, the next try comes in 15 minutes.
Specials no longer show how many balls can have them
Spawn Arts and Completion: event specials that only ever spawned on one or two balls (Event BE, Event Reichtangle, Event PLC, Event Djibouti, Ballsdex Games Souvenir) now count only for those balls
New Ballsdex → Completion tab: which balls you own and which are still missing, for the whole dex or for one special, straight from Ballsdex (no sync needed)
Profiles with Ballsdex stats show your official completion
Specials show how many balls can have them
Spawn Arts: Ballsdex balls list the specials they can have; hover an emoji for its name, click it to open the special
Profiles can show your last Ballsdex catches (turn it off in Edit profile)
Ballsdex sync progress and the Fast Sync check now count Bronze, Silver and Gold compressed cards correctly, so Fast Sync no longer rejects exports of accounts that have them
Clearer messages when Ballsdex temporarily switches off part of its API
Catch stats now pick up Ballsdex catches correctly (Ballsdex writes its catch message a moment after sending it)
Ballsdex syncs are faster: 50 balls per request instead of 25
When the Ballsdex API limits run out, BallIdentifier waits until they reset instead of trying again, so it doesn't get locked out for longer
Catch stats now work with Ballsdex only
Catch stats explain in the bot logs why a catch wasn't counted (for example, when they are off on that server)
Supported dexes are now managed in one place, so new dexes can be added (or retired) much faster
FoodDex is no longer supported: it was removed from identification, spawn arts, the trainer, collectors and notifier settings
FoodDex is no longer supported: Identify, /info, /collectors, the Notifier and Catch stats no longer work with it
Catch stats recognize catches more reliably, and the bot now reports in its logs when it can't answer a catch (for example, missing permissions)
Bot message previews (Notifier and Catch stats) now show the bot's current Discord avatar
Notifier settings are no longer in the account menu. You'll find them in Bot → Notifier
The command list on the Bot page now matches what the commands actually do (including Sign in with Ballsdex)
Bot page tabs no longer break onto two lines on phones

New: Catch stats. On servers where an admin turns them on, the bot answers each catch with how fast it was, your average, your average and best for that ball, and a shout when you beat your own or the server's record
New /catchstats command: your stats, the server's fastest catchers (all time, 30 or 7 days) and who can see your stats
Catch stats are private by default. "Don't track me" under any catch reply stops tracking and deletes your catch data

New Bot → Catch stats page: what it does and what it saves, rankings of the fastest catchers (all time, 30 days, 7 days), your own stats, and on/off switches for servers you administer, with a choice of what the reply shows or replying only on records
Profiles can show your catch stats. New switches in Edit profile: "Show my catch stats publicly" and "Track my catches"
If syncing or Fast Sync is temporarily turned off (for example when the Ballsdex API limits are tight), the Ballsdex tab and /ballsdex sync now say so instead of trying anyway
/collectors works again
New Limits tab in Ballsdex: see how much of BallIdentifier's shared Ballsdex API limits is used right now (no login needed), your own account's limits, and what uses requests
The theme menu shows each theme as a color circle instead of an icon
Profiles no longer have an accent color setting
If connecting your Ballsdex account hits the API limit, you now see whose limit it was and when to try again

Ballsdex switched to its new API: you now connect your account with Sign in with Ballsdex instead of pasting an API key. Accounts linked with a key keep their stats but need to sign in once more to sync
/ballsdex link in the bot now takes you straight to Sign in with Ballsdex on the website

When the Ballsdex API runs out of requests or is down, linking, syncing, Fast Sync, collector checks and the Specials market now say clearly what happened and when to try again, instead of showing odd errors or loading forever

Public profiles: open Your profile in the account menu to add a bio, pronouns, an accent color, your favorite dex and a showcase of up to 6 balls. Your profile stays private until you make it public, and your Ballsdex stats only show if you turn them on
Profiles show which balls you collect in every dex, and collector names on the Collectors page now open their profile
New Users tab: find other users with a public profile
Shared profile links get their own preview card with avatar, bio, showcase and stats
